Streams a zip, built as it goes, with a `{event_id}/` folder per event
holding the parts asked for: `details` (`event.json`), `frames`
(`frames.json`), `images`, `video` and `misc` (the event directory's other
files). Every id is checked first: one that doesn't exist or isn't
visible to the caller is a 404 and nothing is sent.

404.description: An event doesn't exist or isn't visible

get.summary: Live events and alarm states (Server-Sent Events)
get.description:
One stream for every monitor the caller may see (or `monitor_id`). The
SSE `event` name is the message `type`:

- `alarm_state` `{monitor_id, state, score}`: `idle`, `prealarm`,
  `alarm`, `alert`, or `unknown`. Sent for every monitor on connect,
  then on each change.
- `event_start`, `event_end`, `event_updated` (its notes changed, where
  object detection writes): `{event_id, monitor_id, name, cause, notes,
  start_date_time, end_date_time, frames, alarm_frames, max_score, length}`.
  The SSE `id` is the event id: reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (or
  `?since=`) to replay what was missed, up to 500 events.
- `lagged`: the subscriber fell behind and missed messages; reconnect
  with `Last-Event-ID`.

A heartbeat comment every 15 s. The stream ends when the access token
expires, or when the user loses access (checked every minute).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Replay events with a higher id first (as `Last-Event-ID` does), at
most 500.

get.description:

ready (poll `…/synopsis` first).

get.summary: WebSocket handler for WebRTC signaling.
get.description:
Upgrades to a WebSocket and exchanges WebRTC signaling over JSON **text
frames**. OpenAPI cannot type WebSocket message bodies, so the message
schema is documented here and as the `WebRtcSignalingMessage` component.

## Message envelope

Every frame is a JSON object discriminated by a lowercase `type` field
(see the `WebRtcSignalingMessage` schema). Note the field casing:
`icecandidate` (one word) with camelCase `sdpMid` / `sdpMLineIndex`.

## Typical flow (client-initiated, the common path)

1. **Server → client** `{"type":"offer","session_id":"<id>","sdp":"..."}`
   — the server sends its SDP offer immediately on connect.
2. **Client → server** `{"type":"answer","session_id":"<id>","sdp":"..."}`.
3. **Both directions** `{"type":"icecandidate","session_id":"<id>",`
   `"candidate":"candidate:...","sdpMid":"0","sdpMLineIndex":0}` — trickled
   as discovered.
4. **Server → client** `{"type":"ready","session_id":"<id>","monitor_id":N,`
   `"has_audio":false}` once media is flowing. `has_audio` tells the client
   whether an audio track accompanies the video.
5. **Errors** arrive as `{"type":"error","message":"..."}`.
6. **Keepalive**: either side may send `{"type":"ping"}`; the peer replies
   `{"type":"pong"}`.

101.description: WebSocket upgraded. Frames are JSON `WebRtcSignalingMessage` objects (text). Server sends `offer`/`ready`/`icecandidate`/`error`/`pong`; client sends `answer`/`icecandidate`/`ping`.

`sort_by` (default `time`) and `sort` (asc/desc; default newest-first).

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component name, or a comma list of them (e.g. 'zmc,zma')

parameters.name: min_level
parameters.description: Severity threshold: fatal|error|warning|info|debug, returns that severity or worse

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Exact Logs.Level match, one value or a comma list (inverted scale: 0=Info, -1=Warning, -2=Error, -3=Fatal, -4=Panic, -5=Audit, positive=debug)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the message

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Only logs at or after this Unix time (seconds)

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only logs at or before this Unix time (seconds)

parameters.name: unfiltered_total
parameters.description: Also return total_unfiltered, the whole table's row count. Costs a second COUNT(*).

delete.summary:

the list endpoint. Returns the number of rows deleted. Requires System

parameters.name: component

parameters.name: min_level
parameters.description: Only clear this severity or worse (fatal|error|warning|info|debug)

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Only clear these exact Logs.Level values (one or a comma list)

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Only clear these log ids, comma-separated. An empty or unparseable list is a 400, never "clear everything".

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only clear messages containing this substring

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Only clear logs at or after this Unix time (seconds)

get.summary: Stream a monitor's status changes (server-sent events)
get.description:
The first event, `status`, is the current state as a `WorkerStatus`. After
that, each event is named by what changed (`hello`, `worker_state`,
`stream_auth_failed`, `worker_degraded`, `connection_failed`,
`connection_restored`, `capture_failed`, `capture_resumed`, `disconnected`)
and carries a `StatusChange`. Accepts `?token=` for `EventSource`.

get.summary: Get a JPEG snapshot from a live monitor

post.summary: Take a snapshot now on a zm-next monitor
post.description:
Asks the monitor's zm-next worker to encode the current frame (its
`store_snapshot` plugin) and returns the JPEG. Unlike `GET`, which decodes
the last cached keyframe here, this is a fresh frame from the pipeline, and
the file is also kept wherever the plugin's `root` points. The worker's
report comes back in `X-Snapshot-*` headers.

parameters.name: stream_id
parameters.description: Worker stream to snapshot. Omit to use whichever instance answers.

409.description: Monitor is not running on zm-next

503.description: Worker unreachable, no store_snapshot in the pipeline, or timed out

ActionTargetResponse.description:
A monitor an action can drive, and what it can do (ZoneMinder's
`MonitorAction::targetCandidates`).

types.description: The action types its control can perform.

ActionType.description: What the action does to the target monitor's device.

dataset_name.description: Name of the linked dataset, when the listing joins it.

framework.description: One of TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX, OpenVINO, TensorRT, Other.

action.description:
Action to perform: "on" (force an alarm), "off"/"cancel" (cancel a
forced alarm), "disable_alarms" (force alarms off until
"enable_alarms", ZoneMinder's `zmu -n` / `zmu -c`), "status"

cause.description: Short cause string (max 31 chars). Only used when action is "on". Default: "API"

score.description: Alarm score (1-100+). Only used when action is "on". Default: 100

text.description: Description text (max 255 chars). Only used when action is "on".

oneOf.description: A pipeline graph failed validation; each detail is `(path, message)`.

InvalidPipelineError.description: A pipeline graph failed validation; each detail is `(path, message)`.

ApplyStateRequest.description: Request to apply a system state.

state_name.description: Name of the state to apply

AudioLevelResponse.description: A monitor's live audio level, for the monitor editor's meter (#180).

alarm.description: Whether the level is over the threshold; null while zmc isn't running.

level.description: 0-100, the scale `audio_threshold` uses; null while zmc isn't running.

AxisCapabilities.description: Capability flags for an axis (zoom, focus, iris, gain, white balance)

can.description: Can perform this operation at all

AxisRange.description: Range limits for a PTZ axis (pan, tilt, zoom, etc.)

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Self-service password change for the authenticated user (`PUT /me/password`).

requires.description:
`Config.Requires`, raw: clauses like `ZM_OPT_USE_AUTH=1;ZM_AUTH_RELAY=hashed`
that must all hold for the option to apply (#183).

source.description:
`db`, or `file` when zm.conf or a conf.d file sets the option. A file
wins everywhere, so `value` is then the file's (blank for a private
one) and the option can't be changed through the API.

source_file.description: The file that sets it, for `source: "file"`.

num_classes.description: Number of classes the dataset defines (COCO = 80).

dataset_id.description: Dataset whose classes this model predicts.

model_path.description: Filesystem path to the model weights.

class_index.description: Index this class occupies in the model's output vector.

encoder.description: The encoder the parameters are for, e.g. `libx264`.

CreateFilterRequest.description:
Create a saved event filter. `name` and `query_json` are required; every
other column of the `Filters` table is optional and falls back to the
schema default when omitted (flags `0`, `execute_interval` `60`,
`email_format` `Individual`).

oneOf.description:
Structured, SQLi-safe filter AST. When present it is validated and
translated to ZoneMinder's flat `query_json` for storage.

query_json.description:
Raw ZoneMinder `query_json`. Optional when `filter` (the structured AST)
is supplied — in that case the AST is translated and wins.

event_id.description: Event ID this frame belongs to

frame_id.description: Frame sequence number within the event

ttl_seconds.description:
Lifetime in seconds, 60 to 31536000 (365 days). Default 2592000
(30 days).

menu_key.description: The navbar entry this row configures, e.g. `Console`.

audio_file.description:
The sound to play, for `AudioPlay`; within the target control's
`min_audio_file..=max_audio_file`.

target_monitor_id.description: The monitor whose device is driven; often not this one.

analysis_image_opacity.description: Alpha applied when compositing the analysis image over the frame.

audio_alarm_score.description: Score an audio alarm contributes; upstream default 9.

audio_detection.description: Audio-level alarm detection on the recorded audio (1.39.31); 0 = off.

audio_threshold.description: Audio level (0-255) above which audio detection alarms.

default_player.description: Player the web UI uses for this monitor by default.

oneOf.description: Whether this monitor is a camera or an IP speaker (1.39.30). Defaults to Camera.

enabled.description:
Whether the monitor is enabled (ZoneMinder's `Monitors.Enabled`).
Defaults to enabled when omitted.

object_detection.description: Detector to use, or `none` to disable object detection.

object_detection_model.description: Name of the AI model used for object detection.

record_audio.description: Boolean. The old `min = -1` accepted a value the column has no meaning for.

save_jpe_gs.description:
`Monitors.SaveJPEGs` is a two-bit mask, not a flag: bit 0 saves
captured frames and bit 1 saves analysis images, so 3 means both — and
3 is the column default, which the old `max = 1` rejected (GH #39).

wall_clock_timestamps.description: Stamp events with wall-clock rather than stream timestamps.

oneOf.description: What the live view renders: video, audio visualization, or both.

CreateNotificationRequest.description:
Register a push token. A token already registered is updated in place,
as ZoneMinder's `notifications.json` does.

monitor_list.description: Comma-separated monitor ids to notify for; empty or absent for all.

user_id.description: The owner. Only a System editor may set it; otherwise it is the caller.

CreateRoleRequest.description:
Create a role: a named permission set users hold through `role_id`.
Omitted permission levels default to `None` (a role grants only what it
names).

protocol.description: `http` or `https`, as the legacy Servers modal offers.

zmstats.description: Run this daemon on this server.

do_delete.description:
Whether deleting an event may remove its media from this storage.
Defaults to `1`, matching the column and ZoneMinder's own UI — a
storage created with `0` cannot be reclaimed by retention.

name.description:
Required since ZoneMinder 1.39.19 (`User_Preferences.Name` is NOT NULL
and unique per user).

allOf.description: Per-feature permission levels. Omitted features default to `View`.

api_enabled.description: Whether the user may authenticate to the API (`APIEnabled`).

role_id.description:
The user's role (`GET /api/v3/roles`); its permissions add to the
user's own.

allOf.description: The thresholds the preset applies to a zone (#188).

num_coords.description:
Ignored: the count is taken from `coords`. Kept so existing clients
that send it still validate.

DaemonListResponse.description: Response containing list of all daemons.

DaemonStatusResponse.description: Response containing a single daemon's status.

failure_reason.description:
Why supervision stopped restarting this daemon. It stays stopped until
started again explicitly.

last_exit_code.description: Exit status of the most recent exit, when it exited normally

prompt.description: One-off prompt replacing the pipeline's configured one for this call.

stream_id.description: Worker stream to describe. Omit to use whichever instance answers.

DescribeNowResponse.description: A scene description produced on request by the monitor's `describe_vlm`.

pts_usec.description: Presentation timestamp of the described frame, microseconds.

EventAuditResponse.description:
Legacy's "Audit Events Report": per monitor, the events overlapping a
window, the gaps between them, and those whose media is missing or empty.

EventCountsByMonitorResponse.description: Response for event counts grouped by monitor

ids.description: The events to export, at most 500.

alarm_frames_min.description: Filter events with at least this many alarm frames

archived.description: Filter to show only archived events

cause.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the event cause.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the event name.

notes.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the event notes.

q.description:
Free-text search, as legacy's events search box: a substring match
over Id, MonitorId, StorageId, Name, Cause, StartDateTime,
EndDateTime, Length, Frames, AlarmFrames, TotScore, AvgScore,
MaxScore, Archived, Emailed, Notes and DiskSpace, any of which may
match (#136).

oneOf.description: Field to sort results by (default: start_time)

storage_id.description: Filter by the storage the event's media lives on.

tag_id.description:
Filter to events carrying any of these tag ids (comma-separated, e.g.
`tag_id=1,4,5`). Standard query strings can't repeat a key into a list,
so a comma-separated value is used. `none` keeps events with no tag and
`any` keeps events with at least one; legacy's `0` and `-1` mean the same.

oneOf.description: `in` (default) keeps what `tag_id` matches, `not_in` keeps the rest.

totals.description:
Also return `total_length_seconds` and `total_disk_space` summed over
the whole result, not the page. Off by default: it is a second
aggregate query.

max_score_frame_id.description:
The frame with the highest score (`MaxScoreFrameId`): what a client
reports as the matching frame (#176).

path.description:
The event's directory, as the server resolves it from its storage and
scheme (what ZoneMinder's event page shows as Path). Only on
`GET /events/{id}`; whether the media is still there is what
`GET /events/{id}/info` answers (#140).

EventSummary.description: Lightweight event summary for embedding in TagDetailResponse

EventSummaryResponse.description: Event counts and disk space summary for a monitor

archived_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by archived events (bytes)

day_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last day (bytes)

hour_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last hour (bytes)

month_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last month (bytes)

total_event_disk_space.description: Total disk space used by events (bytes)

week_event_disk_space.description: Disk space used by events in the last week (bytes)

archived.description: Mark event as archived (protected from auto-deletion)

emailed.description: Mark event as having been emailed

executed.description: Mark event as having triggered an external action

locked.description: Lock event to prevent deletion by filters

messaged.description: Mark event as having been sent via push notification

uploaded.description: Mark event as having been uploaded to external storage

in_progress.description:
True while the event is still recording (no `EndDateTime`). Codec/size
fields may be unknown until it finalizes; play via `playlist.m3u8`.

playable_direct.description:
True when the codec plays in any browser `<video>` (H.264). HEVC is
Safari / hardware-Chrome only.

recommended_mode.description:
Suggested playback endpoint: "direct" (progressive MP4), "hls" (VOD), or
"event" (in-progress live HLS via `playlist.m3u8`).

EventVideoResponse.description: A video file in an event's directory.

rate.description:
From a generated file's name (zmvideo.pl's `-r`, `-R`, `-s` and `-S`
parts), when present.

recorded.description: The event's own recording (`DefaultVideo`); it can't be deleted here.

ExportPart.description: What goes into each event's folder in the zip.

oneOf.description:
A bracketed group — `match` joins its `rules` with AND (`all`) or OR
(`any`). Nesting groups gives arbitrarily deep brackets.

value.description:
The comparison value. Omitted for `is_null`/`is_not_null`; an array
for `in`/`not_in`; otherwise a scalar. Always treated as data.

FilterExpr.description:
One node of the filter tree: either a bracketed group of sub-expressions
joined by AND/OR, or a single leaf condition.

FilterField.description:
Whitelisted attributes a filter may reference. Each maps to a real column
(and a ZoneMinder attribute name) in `service::filter_field`. Most are
`Events` columns; a few are joined `Monitors`/`Storage` attributes.

FilterOp.description:
Comparison operators a condition may use. A closed set mapped to fixed SQL
operators downstream — never interpolated.

FilterQuery.description:
A complete structured filter query: a root predicate plus optional sort and
row limit.

limit.description: Optional row limit applied by the downstream executor.

FilterResponse.description:
A saved event filter. Mirrors every column of the `Filters` table so the API
(and its OpenAPI schema) faithfully represents a ZoneMinder filter rather
than a lossy subset.

oneOf.description:
The stored `query_json` parsed into the structured AST, when it maps to
our vocabulary. `None` for legacy/unmodelled filters. Populated by the
service layer (the `From<&Model>` conversion leaves it `None`).

audio_level.description:
Peak audio level since the previous frame row, 0-100 on the scale
`Monitors.AudioThreshold` uses; 0 means silence or no audio

event_id.description: Event ID this frame belongs to; with `frame_id`, the frame's key

format.description: One of `ZM_FFMPEG_FORMATS`; defaults to its starred entry.

fps.description: A fixed output frame rate. Exclusive with `rate`.

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name; otherwise an existing one is the result.

rate.description:
Playback speed relative to real time (2 is twice as fast). Exclusive
with `fps`.

scale.description: Scale relative to the event's size. Exclusive with `size`.

Level.description:
A permission level, ordered `None < View < Edit < Create`.

`Create` only exists for `Monitors`: ZoneMinder lets `Edit` change
existing monitors but only `Create` add new ones.

LightStatusResponse.description:
The lights' state as the camera reports it (#190); null where the control
has no such light or the daemon gave no answer.

oneOf.description:
Most-recent WebRTC startup profile (connect→offer→first-RTP), when a
session has run since boot. Lets you confirm cold-vs-warm empirically.

LocaleResponse.description:
Server locale: the effective timezone + ZoneMinder's date/time format
patterns, so clients can render server-local time consistently with the
legacy web UI (GH #33). Pairs with event timestamps now being true UTC.

timezone.description:
Effective IANA timezone name (from ZoneMinder's `ZM_TIMEZONE`, or the
host OS zone when that is empty). May be `null` if it can't be resolved.

utc_offset.description: Current UTC offset of the server, e.g. `+10:00`.

utc_offset_seconds.description: Current UTC offset in seconds (e.g. 36000 for +10:00).

LogLevel.description:
A ZoneMinder log severity, named instead of numeric.

ZoneMinder's `Logs.Level` scale is inverted — more negative is more severe
(`0`=Info, `-1`=Warning, `-2`=Error, `-3`=Fatal; positive values are debug
levels). Clients should filter by name via `min_level` rather than reasoning
about the numeric direction.

LogQueryParams.description: Query parameters for listing (and clearing) logs.

component.description: Exact component name, or a comma list of them (`zmc,zma`).

end.description: Only logs at or before this Unix time (seconds; `TimeKey`).

ids.description:
Only these log ids, as a comma list. On `DELETE` this clears the rows
an operator selected.

level.description:
Exact `Logs.Level` match, one value or a comma list (`-1,-5`), on
ZoneMinder's inverted numeric scale: 0=Info, -1=Warning, -2=Error,
-3=Fatal, -4=Panic, -5=Audit, positive=debug. For "this severe or
worse", use `min_level` instead.

oneOf.description:
Filter to this severity **or worse** (`fatal` < `error` < `warning` <
`info` < `debug`). E.g. `min_level=error` returns errors and fatals.
Preferred over the raw numeric `level`.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the log message.

oneOf.description:
Sort direction: `asc` or `desc` (default). With the default `sort_by`
that is oldest or newest first.

start.description: Only logs at or after this Unix time (seconds; `TimeKey`).

unfiltered_total.description:
Also return `total_unfiltered`, the row count of the whole table. Off
by default: it is a second `COUNT(*)` over `Logs` on every request.

file.description: Source file that generated the log

line.description: Line number in the source file

pid.description: Process ID that generated the log

time_key.description: Timestamp as Unix epoch with microseconds (e.g., 1234567890.123456)

LogSortField.description: Column the log list is ordered by.

password.description:
Whatever the account's password is. ZoneMinder sets no minimum (its
default login is `admin`/`admin`), so a minimum here only locked
existing users out (#174); setting a password still enforces one.

MeResponse.description:
The authenticated caller's account plus the metadata carried by their
current access token, so a client can show "signed in as / expires at"
without decoding the JWT itself (GH #37).

output.description: For a video, the file name in the event's directory.

params.description: The parameters the job was queued with.

MediaLinkResponse.description: A signed playlist link for a player that can only authenticate in the URL.

expires_at.description: Unix time the link stops working.

playlist_url.description:
The playlist path with its signature, ready for a player: prefix it
with the server's origin. The playlist signs every URI it lists.

token.description:
The signature alone (`st`), for building other URLs of the same
monitor or event.

label.description: Label to show instead of the entry's default one.

oneOf.description: `null` for a value this build doesn't know (a newer ZoneMinder).

first_start.description: Start of the first event in the window.

last_end.description: End of the last event in the window.

min_gap_seconds.description:
Smallest and largest gap, in seconds, from one event's end to the
next one's start: negative where events overlap. Null with fewer than
two events.

missing_files.description: Events whose video (or, without one, whose directory) isn't on disk.

zero_size.description: Events whose video file is empty.

MonitorEventCount.description: Event count per monitor (for console view)

MonitorPipelineResponse.description: A monitor's stored zm-next processing plugin graph (the "free graph").

max_fps.description: A decimal string such as `"5.000"`, as other decimals in the API.

analysis_image_opacity.description: Alpha applied when compositing the analysis image over the frame (0-255).

audio_detection.description: Audio-level alarm detection (1.39.31): on/off, trigger level, alarm score.

object_detection.description: Per-monitor object detection: the detector in use (`none` when off).

object_detection_model.description: Name of the AI model used for object detection.

stream_channel.description:
Stream source channel. Replaces the old `RTSP2WebStream` column, which
ZoneMinder renamed to `StreamChannel` in 1.37.79.

what_display.description: What the live view renders: video, audio visualization, or both.

MonitorStateRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /monitors/{id}/state`. Distinct from the run-state
`UpdateStateRequest` in `dto::request::states`: the two shared a name, and
the OpenAPI spec documented this endpoint with the other one's body (#158).

alarm_state.description:
Live alarm state from the monitor's shared memory: `idle`,
`prealarm`, `alarm` or `alert` (what `zmu -s` reports). Only on
`GET /monitor-status/{id}`, and only while zmc is running.

alarms_disabled.description:
Whether alarms are forced off (`zmu -n`, or `disable_alarms` on the
alarm endpoint). Same availability as `alarm_state`.

analysing.description: Whether the monitor is analysing right now. Same availability.

NaiveDateTimeWrapper.description: Local wall-clock time with no offset, as stored by ZoneMinder

oneOf.description: `null` for a value this build doesn't know.

total_disk_space.description:
Summed `disk_space` of every matching event, in bytes. Only with
`totals=true`.

total_length_seconds.description:
Summed `length` of every matching event, in seconds. Only present when
the request asked for it with `totals=true`.

total_unfiltered.description:
Row count of the whole table, ignoring every filter. Only present when
the request asked for it with `unfiltered_total=true`.

PathError.description:
One validation or configure error, located by path, e.g.
`plugins[0].children[1].cfg.iou_threshold`.

PipelineValidationResponse.description: Result of checking a pipeline graph without saving it.

checked_against.description:
`builtin` (zm-api's plugin list, for a worker that offers no schemas) or
the zm-next version whose plugin schemas were used.

PrivacyRequest.description: Record the answer to the privacy statement (#189).

PrivacyResponse.description: The privacy settings after recording an answer.

show_privacy.description: `ZM_SHOW_PRIVACY`: whether the statement is still to be shown.

ProcessState.description: State of a managed daemon process.

PtzCapabilities.description: Complete PTZ capabilities for a camera

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds (optional, for timed movements)

name.description:
Optional name for the preset (when setting). The character set is
restricted to keep names safe to log, store, and pass downstream as
a single argv element to zmcontrol.pl: NUL truncates C strings,
newlines enable log injection, and slashes have no business in a
preset label. The first character may not be `-` either, since a
leading hyphen makes the value indistinguishable from a flag to the
Perl Getopt::Long parser on the receiving end. Any printable,
non-control, non-slash character is OK after that, including Unicode
letters (so non-Latin names still work).

is_native.description: Whether this is a native Rust implementation

created_by.description:
User who created the report. Set by the server from the authenticated
caller, never accepted from the request.

RoleResponse.description:
A ZoneMinder 1.39 role. A user holding it (`role_id`) gets, per feature,
the higher of their own level and the role's.

RtspLinkResponse.description:
Signed RTSP links to a monitor's live video, for players that take one
URL (Home Assistant, VLC, NVRs).

expires_at.description: Unix time the link stops working.

tls_url.description: RTSP over TLS, when the server has an RTSPS port.

url.description: Plain RTSP. Video only, RTP over the RTSP connection (TCP).

SearchCitation.description: One retrieved event in a search response — the verifiable ground truth.

score.description:
Relevance score (reranker score when reranking is on, else the RRF score;
higher is better).

snippet.description: Snippet of the indexed description text.

url.description: API path to the full event.

from.description: Inclusive lower time bound, epoch seconds.

k.description: Number of results to return (1–50, default 10).

monitor_id.description: Restrict to a single monitor (still subject to the caller's ACL).

q.example: a person near the front door at night

to.description: Inclusive upper time bound, epoch seconds.

answer.description:
Grounded NL answer when the router LLM is reachable; else `null` and the
client renders the citations directly.

count.description: Exact count from the SQL count tool for "how many …" queries; else `null`.

zmstats.description:
Per-daemon enable flags (0/1). ZoneMinder's `Servers` table has no
`zmtelemetry` column, so only these four are exposed.

k.description: Number of results to return (1–50, default 10).

citations.description: Events nearest the source event's embedding.

StartLiveRequest.description: Request to start a live stream

StartLiveResponse.description: Response for starting a live stream

StatusChange.description: One change, as sent to SSE subscribers.

detail.description: The event's detail as the worker sent it (empty for hello/disconnect).

disk_space.description: Configured capacity in bytes (`Storages.DiskSpace`), if set.

oneOf.description:
The filesystem the storage's path is on, as `df` reports it: the
disk's own size and use, not the capacity declared for retention. Null
when the path can't be read from this server (#145).

attempt.description: Consecutive failed attempts, when the worker reports it.

since_ms.description: Unix milliseconds of the event that set this state.

SynopsisLayout.description:
The optimiser's output: per-tube shifts plus the resulting length and any
tubes dropped because the frame cap was hit (never silently — logged).

dropped.description: Track ids dropped (too crowded). Surfaced so callers can log/report.

SynopsisStatus.description:
Render lifecycle of a motion-synopsis row (zm-api-owned `event_synopsis`
table — not part of ZoneMinder's schema). Stored as a short portable string
column, so the migration needs no native DB `ENUM` type.

SynopsisStatusView.description: What a `GET …/synopsis` poll reports to the client.

url.description: Populated once `ready`: the mp4 endpoint to fetch.

db_connections.description:
Database connections currently held by the pool (the legacy header's
`DB: n/max`). `None` when the pool cannot be inspected.

db_max_connections.description: Configured maximum size of the database connection pool.

total_disk.description: Total disk space in bytes (root filesystem)

running.description: Whether the daemon controller is running

TagDetailResponse.description: Tag detail response with paginated events

event_count.description: Number of events with this tag

TagSummary.description: Lightweight tag summary for embedding in EventResponse

TokenType.description:
Which of the two token kinds a JWT is. Access and refresh tokens are
otherwise structurally identical `UserClaims`, separated only by the key
pair that signs them; `typ` makes the distinction explicit so a
misconfiguration that pointed both key paths at the same pair could not
silently let a refresh token act as an access token (or vice versa).

TriggerOn.description:
When an action fires. zmc fires all but `Manual`, which a client runs
with `POST /monitors/{id}/actions/{action_id}/run`.

TubePlacement.description: Where one tube ends up on the synopsis timeline.

group_id.description: Interaction group this tube belongs to (members share a `start_shift_us`).

start_shift_us.description:
Microseconds added to every original timestamp of the tube to move it onto
the synopsis timeline (can be negative — tubes usually shift earlier).

dataset_id.description: Set to re-point the model at another dataset. `null` clears it.

description.description: `null` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged.

UpdateFilterRequest.description:
Patch a saved event filter. Every field is optional; only the ones provided
are changed.

oneOf.description: Structured filter AST; when present it is translated to `query_json`.

parent_id.description:
Re-parent the group. Omit to leave the parent unchanged; `null` clears
it (top-level group); a group id nests under that group. Self-parenting
and cycles are rejected (GH #28).

UpdateMenuItemRequest.description: Partial update. For `label`, `icon` and `link`, `null` clears the value.

audio_file.description: `null` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged.

analysis_image_opacity.description: Alpha applied when compositing the analysis image over the frame.

default_player.description: Player the web UI uses for this monitor by default.

object_detection.description: Detector to use, or `none` to disable object detection.

object_detection_model.description: Name of the AI model used for object detection.

record_audio.description: Boolean. The old `min = -1` accepted a value the column has no meaning for.

save_jpe_gs.description:
`Monitors.SaveJPEGs` is a two-bit mask, not a flag: bit 0 saves
captured frames and bit 1 saves analysis images, so 3 means both — and
3 is the column default, which the old `max = 1` rejected (GH #39).

wall_clock_timestamps.description: Stamp events with wall-clock rather than stream timestamps.

oneOf.description: What the live view renders: video, audio visualization, or both.

monitor_list.description: `null` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged.

description.description: `null` clears it; omit to leave it unchanged.

UpdateServerRequest.description: Partial update: a field left out is unchanged; `null` clears a nullable one.

do_delete.description:
Whether ZoneMinder may delete media from this area (`DoDelete`, 0/1);
the reaper and event deletes honour it (#185).

password.description: New password (re-hashed with bcrypt; never stored in plaintext).

role_id.description: The user's role; `null` removes it. Omit to leave it unchanged.

token_min_expiry.description:
Set the token-revocation floor (unix seconds). Setting it to "now"
revokes all of the user's outstanding tokens (admin revoke-all).

UpdateUserRequest.description: Partial update: every field is optional and only provided fields change.

allOf.description: Thresholds to change; omitted ones are left alone (#188).

UpdateZoneRequest.description: Partial update: a field left out is unchanged; `null` clears a nullable one.

coords.description: New polygon; `num_coords` and `area` are recomputed from it.

UserPermissions.description: A snapshot of a user's per-feature permission levels, embedded in the JWT.

UserPermissionsInput.description:
The eight ZoneMinder per-feature permission levels. Each is optional so a
request can set only the ones it cares about.

Values are the same names `UserResponse` reports: `None` / `View` / `Edit`
(`Stream` has no `Edit`; `Monitors` also accepts `Create`). They are taken
as strings and parsed, because the generated entity enums do not derive
`ToSchema` and `src/entity/` is a generated artifact we don't hand-edit.

role_id.description: The user's role, whose permissions add to the levels above.

VideoTransform.description: A filter for the generated video, as ZoneMinder's Generate Video offers.

has_audio.description:
Whether the session carries an audio track (G.711 pass-through
or AAC transcoded to Opus) alongside the video track

WebRtcSignalingMessage.description:
WebRTC signaling message types.

This is the *actual* wire format exchanged over the
`/api/v3/live/{monitor_id}/webrtc/ws` WebSocket (text frames, JSON). The
discriminator is the `type` field, lowercased: `offer`, `answer`,
`icecandidate`, `ready`, `error`, `ping`, `pong`.

WebRtcStartupView.description:
Server-side WebRTC startup timing surfaced on `/live/{id}/stats`. All `*_ms`
are from WS connect and nest: `get_source_ms ≤ offer_ms ≤ ice_connected_ms ≤
connected_ms ≤ first_rtp_ms`.

connected_ms.description:
connect → peer Connected (ICE+DTLS). `connected_ms − ice_connected_ms` is
the DTLS handshake (the structural ~1.1s offerer-passive cost on a LAN).

offer_ms.description:
connect → SDP offer sent. With trickle ICE this no longer waits on ICE
gathering / STUN, so it collapses toward the floor.

warm_start.description: Reader was already hot at connect (no reader spin-up on the offer path).

WorkerStatus.description: What zm-api knows about a worker right now.

control_protocol.description:
Control protocol version from the hello; absent for a worker that
predates it.

degraded.description: Component → effect, for each dependency the worker reports as down.

state.description:
`unconfigured` | `configuring` | `running` | `stopping`, from the hello
or the latest worker_state event.

streams.description: Keyed by the worker's stream id.

zm_next_version.description: zm-next version and commit from the hello.

ZmNextWorkerStatusResponse.description: A monitor's zm-next worker, as the daemon manager sees it.

oneOf.description:
What the worker last reported over its socket (hello and status
events): state, pipeline hash, per-stream health, degraded components.
Absent until zm-api has read from the monitor's socket.

supervised.description: zm-api supervises daemons on this server (not passive mode).

oneOf.description: The worker's process entry; absent if it was never started.

min_pixel_threshold.description: The thresholds the preset applies, named as on `ZoneResponse` (#188).

ZonePresetThresholds.description:
A zone preset's thresholds, named as on `ZoneResponse` so a client can copy
them to a zone one to one. On update, an omitted field is left alone.
